Name: Shut Up
Author: GekoX
Description:
[size=6]Stardew Valley 1.6 supported![/size]

Prevents certain sounds from playing.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game once to generate the config.
[*]Add the names of the sounds you want to not play to the config. The names of sounds can be found [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#Track_list]here[/url]﻿﻿﻿. Please note that ShutUp will not shut up music.
[*]Enjoy peace and quiet!
[/list]
[size=5]Example Config
[/size]This is an example config that will silence the pet dog's bark.
[size=2][code]{
  "showDebugSpam": false,
  "sounds": [
    "dog_pant",
    "dog_bark"
  ]
}
[/code][/size]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows. Untested on Android.
[/list]
